description: This Java class implements a command handler for deleting provisioning criteria within the Fineract platform. It listens for delete commands related to provisioning criteria and delegates the delete operation to a service layer.

classes.name: DeleteProvisioningCriteriaRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles delete commands for provisioning criteria by implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the delete command by invoking the delete method on the provisioningCriteriaWritePlatformService with the provided entity ID.
